title: Startup requests that reach the roster reliably
summary: Send the protected startup snapshot through a bounded authenticated request that works on the affected Samsung browser.
changes: The startup snapshot now bypasses the client wrapper that failed to dispatch on the affected Samsung browser.
The same protected schema-37 function still returns the account, staffing, allocations and essential settings together.
Saved-roster recovery remains read-only and now has an executable regression check.
No changes to roster, staffing, allocation, Pager, Reliever, five-nurse, realtime, privacy or write rules.
